title: Ohm Brew Sensation X 50/50 Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Sensation X is Ohm Brew’s first Menthol recipe and it delivers on every front. That unmistakable minty freshness and the pure refreshment of menthol is given a subtle, beguiling complexity in this fabulous juice that should be in every menthol lover’s tank. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend hits the sweet spot between flavour and cloud production and the nic salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts.
